cards.name: Accelgor
cards.description: It moves with blinding speed and lobs poison at foes. Featuring Accelgor as a main character is a surefire way to make a movie or comic popular.

cards.name: Grimer
cards.description: The wastewater coming from factories is clean these days, so Grimer have nothing to eat. They're said to be on the verge of extinction.

cards.name: Muk
cards.description: Because they scatter germs everywhere, they've long been targeted for extermination, leading to a steep decline in their population.

cards.name: Spinarak
cards.description: Although the poison from its fangs isn't that strong, it's potent enough to weaken prey that gets caught in its web.

cards.name: Ariados
cards.description: It spews threads from its mouth to catch its prey. When night falls, it leaves its web to go hunt aggressively.

cards.name: Darkrai
cards.description: It can lull people to sleep and make them dream. It is active during nights of the new moon.

cards.name: Purrloin
cards.description: It steals things from people just to amuse itself with their frustration. A rivalry exists between this Pokémon and Nickit.

cards.name: Liepard
cards.description: Don't be fooled by its gorgeous fur and elegant figure. This is a moody and vicious Pokémon.

cards.name: Deino
cards.description: When it encounters something, its first urge is usually to bite it. If it likes what it tastes, it will commit the associated scent to memory.

cards.name: Zweilous
cards.description: While hunting for prey, Zweilous wanders its territory, its two heads often bickering over which way to go.

cards.name: Rowlet
cards.description: At a distance, it launches its sharp feathers while flying about. If the enemy gets too close, Rowlet switches tactics and delivers vicious kicks.

cards.name: Hydreigon
cards.description: There are a slew of stories about villages that were destroyed by Hydreigon. It bites anything that moves.

cards.name: Hoopa
cards.description: It gathers things it likes and passes them through its loop to teleport them to a secret place.

cards.name: Nickit
cards.description: Aided by the soft pads on its feet, it silently raids the food stores of other Pokémon. It survives off its ill-gotten gains.

cards.name: Thievul
cards.description: It secretly marks potential targets with a scent. By following the scent, it stalks its targets and steals from them when they least expect it.

cards.name: Dartrix
cards.description: It throws one knifelike feather after another at its enemies, and each one precisely strikes a weak point. These feathers are known as blade quills.

cards.name: Skarmory
cards.description: Its body is draped in steel armor. It looks heavy, but it can fly at speeds of up to 185 miles an hour!

cards.name: Aron
cards.description: When it evolves, it sheds the steel carapace that covered its whole body and develops a new one.

cards.name: Lairon
cards.description: It habitually shows off its strength with the sparks it creates by ramming its steel body into boulders.

cards.name: Aggron
cards.description: While seeking iron for food, it digs tunnels by breaking through bedrock with its steel horns.

cards.name: Escavalier
cards.description: They use shells they've stolen from Shelmet to arm and protect themselves. They're very popular Pokémon in the Galar region.

cards.name: Klink
cards.description: The two minigears that compose this Pokémon are closer than twins. They mesh well only with each other.

cards.name: Klang
cards.description: When Klang goes all out, the minigear links up perfectly with the outer part of the big gear, and this Pokémon's rotation speed increases sharply.

cards.name: Klinklang
cards.description: From its spikes, it launches powerful blasts of electricity. Its red core contains an enormous amount of energy.

cards.name: Meltan
cards.description: It dissolves and eats metal. Circulating liquid metal within its body is how it generates energy.

cards.name: Decidueye
cards.description: As if wielding a bow, it launches the arrow quills hidden among the feathers of its wings. Decidueye's shots never miss.

cards.name: Melmetal
cards.description: At the end of its life-span, Melmetal will rust and fall apart. The small shards left behind will eventually be reborn as Meltan.

cards.name: Cufant
cards.description: It digs up the ground with its trunk. It's also very strong, being able to carry loads of over five tons without any problem at all.

cards.name: Copperajah
cards.description: They came over from another region long ago and worked together with humans. Their green skin is resistant to water.

cards.name: Kangaskhan
cards.description: You shouldn't get close to the child when it's playing outside its mother's pouch. Its mother is always nearby watching over it.

cards.name: Tauros
cards.description: They live in groups. The one with the longest, thickest, and most-scarred horns is the boss of the herd.

cards.name: Sentret
cards.description: It stands on its tail so it can see a long way. If it spots an enemy, it cries loudly to warn its kind.

cards.name: Furret
cards.description: It makes a nest to suit its long and skinny body. The nest is impossible for other Pokémon to enter.

cards.name: Dunsparce
cards.description: When it sees a person, it digs a hole with its tail to make its escape. If you happen to find one, consider yourself lucky.

cards.name: Teddiursa
cards.description: Before food becomes scarce in wintertime, its habit is to hoard food in many hidden locations.

cards.name: Ursaring
cards.description: Although it has a large body, it is quite skilled at climbing trees. It eats and sleeps in the treetops.

cards.name: Bounsweet
cards.description: Its body gives off a sweet, fruity scent that is extremely appetizing to bird Pokémon.

cards.name: Lugia
cards.description: It is said to be the guardian of the seas. It is rumored to have been seen on the night of a storm.

cards.name: Skitty
cards.description: It shows its cute side by chasing its own tail until it gets dizzy.

cards.name: Delcatty
cards.description: It is highly popular among female Trainers for its sublime fur. It does not keep a nest.

cards.name: Starly
cards.description: They flock around mountains and fields, chasing after bug Pokémon. Their singing is noisy and annoying.

cards.name: Staravia
cards.description: It lives in forests and fields. Squabbles over territory occur when flocks collide.

cards.name: Staraptor
cards.description: When Staravia evolve into Staraptor, they leave the flock to live alone. They have sturdy wings.

cards.name: Ducklett
cards.description: They are better at swimming than flying, and they happily eat their favorite food, peat moss, as they dive underwater.

cards.name: Swanna
cards.description: Swanna start to dance at dusk. The one dancing in the middle is the leader of the flock.

cards.name: Steenee
cards.description: As it twirls like a dancer, a sweet smell spreads out around it. Anyone who inhales the scent will feel a surge of happiness.

cards.name: Bunnelby
cards.description: It excels at digging holes. Using its ears, it can dig a nest 33 feet deep in one night.

cards.name: Fletchling
cards.description: Its body is always warm. Trainers who live in cold areas apparently sleep with it in their bed.

cards.name: Skwovet
cards.description: Found throughout the Galar region, this Pokémon becomes uneasy if its cheeks are ever completely empty of berries.

cards.name: Greedent
cards.description: It stashes berries in its tail—so many berries that they fall out constantly. But this Pokémon is a bit slow-witted, so it doesn't notice the loss.

cards.name: Rookidee
cards.description: It will bravely challenge any opponent, no matter how powerful. This Pokémon benefits from every battle—even a defeat increases its strength a bit.

cards.name: Corvisquire
cards.description: Smart enough to use tools in battle, these Pokémon have been seen picking up rocks and flinging them or using ropes to wrap up enemies.

cards.name: Corviknight
cards.description: This Pokémon reigns supreme in the skies of the Galar region. The black luster of its steel body could drive terror into the heart of any foe.

cards.name: Tsareena
cards.description: This feared Pokémon has long, slender legs and a cruel heart. It shows no mercy as it stomps on its opponents.

cards.name: Wimpod
cards.description: It's nature's cleaner—it eats anything and everything, including garbage and rotten things. The ground near its nest is always clean.

cards.name: Golisopod
cards.description: It will do anything to win, taking advantage of every opening and finishing opponents off with the small claws on its front legs.

cards.name: Rillaboom
cards.description: By drumming, it taps into the power of its special tree stump. The roots of the stump follow its direction in battle.

cards.name: Coalossal
cards.description: It's usually peaceful, but the vandalism of mines enrages it. Offenders will be incinerated with flames that reach 2,700 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Torchic
cards.description: A fire burns inside, so it feels very warm to hug. It launches fireballs of 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Combusken
cards.description: During a battle, the hot flame in its body increases. Its kicks have outstanding destructive power.

cards.name: Blaziken
cards.description: When facing a tough foe, it looses flames from its wrists. Its powerful legs let it jump clear over buildings.

cards.name: Heatran
cards.description: Boiling blood, like magma, circulates through its body. It makes its dwelling place in volcanic caves.

cards.name: Pansear
cards.description: This Pokémon lives in caves in volcanoes. The fire within the tuft on its head can reach 600 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Simisear
cards.description: When it gets excited, embers rise from its head and tail and it gets hot. For some reason, it loves sweets.

cards.name: Galarian Darmanitan
cards.description: Anger has reignited its atrophied flame sac. This Pokémon spews fire everywhere as it rampages indiscriminately.

cards.name: Larvesta
cards.description: It protects itself with flame. Long years ago, people believed Larvesta had a nest on the sun.

cards.name: Paras
cards.description: The mushrooms, known as tochukaso, are controlling the bug. Even if the bug bugs the mushrooms, they tell it to bug off.

cards.name: Volcarona
cards.description: According to legends, it was hatched from a flaming cocoon to save people and Pokémon that were suffering from the cold.

cards.name: Fletchinder
cards.description: Its speed right after takeoff already puts it in the top speed class of all bird Pokémon.

cards.name: Talonflame
cards.description: Bird Pokémon make up most of its diet. It approaches at high speeds and smacks them down to the ground with its powerful kick.

cards.name: Galarian Mr. Mime
cards.description: Its talent is tap-dancing. It can also manipulate temperatures to create a floor of ice, which this Pokémon can kick up to use as a barrier.

cards.name: Galarian Mr. Rime
cards.description: It's highly skilled at tap-dancing. It waves its cane of ice in time with its graceful movements.

cards.name: Suicune
cards.description: Said to be the embodiment of north winds, it can instantly purify filthy, murky water.

cards.name: Feebas
cards.description: Although unattractive and unpopular, this Pokémon's marvelous vitality has made it a subject of research.

cards.name: Milotic
cards.description: Milotic has provided inspiration to many artists. It has even been referred to as the most beautiful Pokémon of all.

cards.name: Parasect
cards.description: The bug is mostly dead, with the mushroom on its back having become the main body. If the mushroom comes off, the bug stops moving.

cards.name: Relicanth
cards.description: The reason it hasn't changed at all in a hundred million years is that it's apparently already a perfect life-form.

cards.name: Panpour
cards.description: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. Plants that receive its water grow large.

cards.name: Simipour
cards.description: It prefers places with clean water. When its tuft runs low, it replenishes it by siphoning up water with its tail.

cards.name: Galarian Darumaka
cards.description: It lived in snowy areas for so long that its fire sac cooled off and atrophied. It now has an organ that generates cold instead.

cards.name: Galarian Darmanitan
cards.description: On days when blizzards blow through, it comes down to where people live. It stashes food in the snowball on its head, taking it home for later.

cards.name: Vanillite
cards.description: Unable to survive in hot areas, it makes itself comfortable by breathing out air cold enough to cause snow. It burrows into the snow to sleep.

cards.name: Vanillish
cards.description: By drinking pure water, it grows its icy body. This Pokémon can be hard to find on days with warm, sunny weather.

cards.name: Vanilluxe
cards.description: When its anger reaches a breaking point, this Pokémon unleashes a fierce blizzard that freezes every creature around it, be they friend or foe.

cards.name: Cubchoo
cards.description: When this Pokémon is in good health, its snot becomes thicker and stickier. It will smear its snot on anyone it doesn't like.

cards.name: Beartic
cards.description: It swims through frigid seas, searching for prey. From its frozen breath, it forms icy fangs that are harder than steel.

cards.name: Carnivine
cards.description: It binds itself to trees in marshes. It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling drool and gulps them down.

cards.name: Wishiwashi
cards.description: Individually, they're incredibly weak. It's by gathering up into schools that they're able to confront opponents.

cards.name: Mareanie
cards.description: The first symptom of its sting is numbness. The next is an itching sensation so intense that it's impossible to resist the urge to claw at your skin.

cards.name: Toxapex
cards.description: To survive in the cold waters of Galar, this Pokémon forms a dome with its legs, enclosing its body so it can capture its own body heat.

cards.name: Dracovish
cards.description: Powerful legs and jaws made it the apex predator of its time. Its own overhunting of its prey was what drove it to extinction.

cards.name: Arctovish
cards.description: Though it's able to capture prey by freezing its surroundings, it has trouble eating the prey afterward because its mouth is on top of its head.

cards.name: Mareep
cards.description: Rubbing its fleece generates electricity. You'll want to pet it because it's cute, but if you use your bare hand, you'll get a painful shock.

cards.name: Flaaffy
cards.description: It stores electricity in its fluffy fleece. If it stores up too much, it will start to go bald in those patches.

cards.name: Ampharos
cards.description: Its tail shines bright and strong. It has been prized since long ago as a beacon for sailors.

cards.name: Electrike
cards.description: It stores static electricity in its fur for discharging. It gives off sparks if a storm approaches.

cards.name: Manectric
cards.description: It stimulates its own muscles with electricity, so it can move quickly. It eases its soreness with electricity, too, so it can recover quickly as well.

cards.name: Pansage
cards.description: It's good at finding berries and gathers them from all over. It's kind enough to share them with friends.

cards.name: Tapu Koko
cards.description: The lightning-wielding guardian deity of Melemele, Tapu Koko is brimming with curiosity and appears before people from time to time.

cards.name: Toxel
cards.description: It stores poison in an internal poison sac and secretes that poison through its skin. If you touch this Pokémon, a tingling sensation follows.

cards.name: Toxtricity
cards.description: Capable of generating 15,000 volts of electricity, this Pokémon looks down on all that would challenge it.

cards.name: Pincurchin
cards.description: It feeds on seaweed, using its teeth to scrape it off rocks. Electric current flows from the tips of its spines.

cards.name: Dracozolt
cards.description: In ancient times, it was unbeatable thanks to its powerful lower body, but it went extinct anyway after it depleted all its plant-based food sources.

cards.name: Arctozolt
cards.description: The shaking of its freezing upper half is what generates its electricity. It has a hard time walking around.

cards.name: Jigglypuff
cards.description: The songs they sing are totally different depending on the region they live in. Some even sound like they're shouting!

cards.name: Wigglytuff
cards.description: When it gets angry, it inhales with all its might, and its body gradually inflates. Sometimes they can grow 20 times larger!

cards.name: Simisage
cards.description: Ill tempered, it fights by swinging its barbed tail around wildly. The leaf growing on its head is very bitter.

cards.name: Snubbull
cards.description: In contrast to its appearance, it's quite timid. When playing with other puppy Pokémon, it sometimes gets bullied.

cards.name: Granbull
cards.description: Although it's popular with young people, Granbull is timid and sensitive, so it's totally incompetent as a watchdog.

cards.name: Lunatone
cards.description: The phase of the moon apparently has some effect on its power. It's active on the night of a full moon.

cards.name: Gothita
cards.description: Though they're still only babies, there's psychic power stored in their ribbonlike feelers, and sometimes they use that power to fight.

cards.name: Gothorita
cards.description: It's said that when stars shine in the night sky, this Pokémon will spirit away sleeping children. Some call it the Witch of Punishment.

cards.name: Gothitelle
cards.description: It has tremendous psychic power, but it dislikes conflict. It's also able to predict the future based on the movement of the stars.

cards.name: Golett
cards.description: They were sculpted from clay in ancient times. No one knows why, but some of them are driven to continually line up boulders.

cards.name: Golurk
cards.description: Artillery platforms built into the walls of ancient castles served as perches from which Golurk could fire energy beams.

cards.name: Dedenne
cards.description: Its upper whiskers are sensors that survey its surroundings. Its lower whiskers are organs that shoot electricity.

cards.name: Morelull
cards.description: Pokémon living in the forest eat the delicious caps on Morelull's head. The caps regrow overnight.

cards.name: Karrablast
cards.description: Its strange physiology reacts to electrical energy in interesting ways. The presence of a Shelmet will cause this Pokémon to evolve.

cards.name: Shiinotic
cards.description: Its flickering spores lure in prey and put them to sleep. Once this Pokémon has its prey snoozing, it drains their vitality with its fingertips.

cards.name: Mimikyu
cards.description: It wears a rag fashioned into a Pikachu costume in an effort to look less scary. Unfortunately, the costume only makes it creepier.

cards.name: Sinistea
cards.description: This Pokémon is said to have been born when a lonely spirit possessed a cold, leftover cup of tea.

cards.name: Polteageist
cards.description: This species lives in antique teapots. Most pots are forgeries, but on rare occasions, an authentic work is found.

cards.name: Diglett
cards.description: If a Diglett digs through a field, it leaves the soil perfectly tilled and ideal for planting crops.

cards.name: Dugtrio
cards.description: A team of Diglett triplets. It triggers huge earthquakes by burrowing 60 miles underground.

cards.name: Larvitar
cards.description: Born deep underground, it comes aboveground and becomes a pupa once it has finished eating the surrounding soil.

cards.name: Pupitar
cards.description: Even sealed in its shell, it can move freely. Hard and fast, it has outstanding destructive power.

cards.name: Tyranitar
cards.description: Its body can't be harmed by any sort of attack, so it is very eager to make challenges against enemies.

cards.name: Trapinch
cards.description: Its nest is a sloped, bowl-like pit in the desert. Once something has fallen in, there is no escape.

cards.name: Shelmet
cards.description: When attacked, it tightly shuts the lid of its shell. This reaction fails to protect it from Karrablast, however, because they can still get into the shell.

cards.name: Vibrava
cards.description: The ultrasonic waves it generates by rubbing its two wings together cause severe headaches.

cards.name: Flygon
cards.description: This Pokémon hides in the heart of sandstorms it creates and seldom appears where people can see it.

cards.name: Solrock
cards.description: When it rotates itself, it gives off light similar to the sun, thus blinding its foes.

cards.name: Hippopotas
cards.description: It moves through the sands with its mouth open, swallowing sand along with its prey. It gets rid of the sand by spouting it from its nose.

cards.name: Hippowdon
cards.description: Stones can get stuck in the ports on their bodies. Dwebble help dislodge such stones, so Hippowdon look after these Pokémon.

cards.name: Diggersby
cards.description: With power equal to an excavator, it can dig through dense bedrock. It's a huge help during tunnel construction.

cards.name: Passimian
cards.description: Displaying amazing teamwork, they follow the orders of their boss as they all help out in the search for their favorite berries.

cards.name: Galarian Sirfetch'd
cards.description: Only Farfetch'd that have survived many battles can attain this evolution. When this Pokémon's leek withers, it will retire from combat.
